unknowns: The public collection id is 7324. The EOS Combined Entity id is not on the public page. Vatican and Colosseum used the same number for both; that pattern was not verified here.
multiVariant and otherPricesExist are true on several cards. The from-price is not labeled with a stay tier (budget, comfort, luxury) or shared versus private.

A rendered fetch of the homepage did not include the sentence 'Crafted by Headout'. That sentence was on the about and fly-in URLs in search snippets. The homepage payload does contain 'Headout Inc'.

Competitor park-fee treatment is not fully comparable. The Viator extract lists a $20 destination payment and an ambiguous park-fee line. The GetYourGuide extract tells the traveler to pay park fees of $200 or $400.

checks.message: Same-currency price observations sit within 1.5% of the catalog from-price. Wider gaps fail. Cross-currency figures are not converted.
From-prices on this collection use more than one unit (per_group, per_person). A single list will not read as a price ladder unless every card shows the unit. Per-group ids are listed.
Every product has a duration.
Every product has a cancellation statement.
Pickup or transfers are marked as depending on the option selected. The collection card does not name the meeting point.
No product card stretches a short experience and a much longer variant into one duration.
7 of 17 products have 0 reviews on the collection card.
Every product title contains one of: masai mara, maasai mara.

The page says “Lake Nakuru National Park (included with 4+ days safaris)”. 6 product(s) meet the duration condition and do not carry the tag 'lake_nakuru'. The same page also says: Masai Mara, or Masai Mara with Lake Naivasha or Lake Nakuru.

The page says “Lake Naivasha & Hell's Gate (included with 4+ days safaris)”. 7 product(s) meet the duration condition and do not carry the tag 'lake_naivasha'. The same page also says: Masai Mara, or Masai Mara with Lake Naivasha or Lake Nakuru.

The page says “Amboseli National Park (included with 5–7-day safaris)”. 3 product(s) meet the duration condition and do not carry the tag 'amboseli'. The same page also says: The comparison table describes 5-day routes as Masai Mara, Lake Nakuru and Lake Naivasha, or Masai Mara and Amboseli.
The microbrand text names Headout, and the fetched copy does not contain a sentence that this is not the venue's website. Travelers can still read the domain as the operator.
Confirmed FAQs are missing these topics: cancellation.
Headout publishes related products that are not in this collection. Titles: From Nairobi: 3-Day Masai Mara Budget Camping Safari.

Viator lists “3 days 2 nights budget group safari to Maasai Mara National Reserve” from 195.56 USD. Comparability is 'fees_unclear'. From $195.56 per person plus $20 paid in destination. Park-fee inclusion was ambiguous in the fetched extract, so this is not a like-for-like gap.

GetYourGuide lists “From Nairobi: Maasai Mara 3-Day Budget Safari Holiday by Jeep” from 345 USD. Comparability is 'fees_unclear'. The fetched page showed $345 per person and told travelers to pay park entrance fees of $200 (Jan–Jun) or $400 (Jul–Dec). Currency was the symbol shown, not a confirmed ISO label. Not like-for-like with Headout cards that say entry fees are included.

5 product pair(s) share a duration, a from-price within 12%, and a title overlap of at least 62%. Review whether both need to sit on the collection. First pairs: 57722 vs 57638 (J=0.917); 61529 vs 61528 (J=0.857); 57712 vs 57728 (J=0.833); 57698 vs 57697 (J=0.8); 57690 vs 57697 (J=0.8)
